gaps.what: Zhu Wen's 907-912 wars and the 911-915 outline are Cliopatria's, unverified; the 922 Wei Prefecture outcome is confidence 1
Who held the Pingliang and southern Ningxia country Cliopatria draws for Qi in 916-925; whether Baoji stayed with Shu after the 916 siege
No month for the 925 invasion or Wang Yan's surrender; Guizhou and Yunnan fringes of the Cliopatria outline unverified
Sixteen Prefectures cession year disputed (936 promised, 937, 938); Liao row must agree. Fan Yanguang's revolt, Chu/Southern Tang/Wuyue tribute undated
No ruler list (Min page contradicts the Yin years); Wang Yanjun's imperial title has no year; Yin's location differs between pages
Wuping Jiedushi 952-963 has no dossier; who took the Guilin and Wuzhou country after 951; dates for Ji, Rong, Gao and Yuan
Zhou Xingfeng URL redirects to the Pan Shusi biography, useless for the Wuping Jiedushi

problems: later-liang-dynasty: Cliopatria's Wikidata Q783489 is the 6th-century Liang dynasty id already used by the liang-dynasty dossier; identity.wikidata is left null (Wikidata unreachable). The two Cliopatria rows are different states and are not merged.
later-jin: Cliopatria's 'Later Jin' 911-921 shape is Li Keyong's and Li Cunxu's Jin (Later Tang precursor) and is verdict wrong; the former-jin dossier (another batch) must cover those years.

later-jin: a new keyframe id 'later-jin_936b' (936 only) uses a letter suffix, which Cliopatria's convention gives to a second shape sharing FromYear; downstream tools should treat it as new (absent from shapes.csv).

later-jin and liao-dynasty: the Sixteen Prefectures year disagrees across pages (936/937/938) and Cliopatria's Liao shape holds the land from 936; the Liao dossier (ea-05) needs to agree with the 938 loss or the 937 keyframe.

Page budget (1-2 per state) was exceeded for every state, 20 distinct pages in all, because the state articles for Former Shu, Qi, Min and Later Tang are nearly empty; the dated events come from the biographies (Wang Jian, Wang Yan, Li Maozhen, Zhu Youzhen, Wang Shenzhi, Wang Yanzheng, Ma Yin, Shi Chonggui) and the Southern Tang page.

WebFetch returns model summaries, not page text; where a summary was internally inconsistent (Later Liang Wei Prefecture 922; Qi names Li Jiyan/Li Congyan, not Li Jiqian) the dossier says so and lowers confidence.

Rules applied by judgment: nominal investiture and tribute (Chu, Min, Southern Han to Later Liang; Qi, Chu, Min to Later Tang) are not drawn as vassal tints; and the Cliopatria Southern Chu, Qi, Later Liang and Former Shu outlines are cut where pages contradict them (see notes). A reviewer who disagrees can reverse any of these from the notes.
